title: Go out · phrasal verb
subtitle: 「出門／外出消遣／出去走走」，究竟是哪一種 go out？
description: 「出門／外出消遣／出去走走」，究竟是哪一種 go out？

words.note: 最直接、最自然的近義片語之一，表示離開目前所在的地方並開始外出行程；語氣口語，常用於休閒、社交或辦事。
words.example: We're heading out for dinner in a few minutes.
words.exampleZh: 我們幾分鐘後就會出門吃晚飯。

exercises.original: We're going out for dinner at about seven.
exercises.zh: 我們大約七時會出門吃晚飯。
exercises.upgrade: head out · 出門；外出

options.explanation: staying in = stay in 表示留在家，和出門吃飯相反。
commuting = 吃晚飯不是規律上下班通勤。
head out = for dinner 表示即將離開目前位置開始外出活動，head out 很自然。
travelling = 普通本地晚餐不需要用較廣的 travel。
visiting = 句子沒有要拜訪某個人或地方的意思。
walking = 只是移動方式，不能概括整個外出活動。

exercises.original: I think we'll go out once the traffic gets lighter.
exercises.zh: 我想等交通沒那麼擠時我們就會出門。
exercises.upgrade: head out · 出門；外出

options.explanation: go outside = 只表示走到戶外，不足以表達開始一段行程。
commute = 不是固定工作路線。
stay in = 意思相反。
head out = 等交通改善後開始外出行程，最自然可用 head out。
visit = 未指定拜訪對象。
wander = 會多出漫無目的走動的意思。

exercises.original: We went out early so we could get good seats at the concert.
exercises.zh: 我們提早出門，以便在演唱會找到好座位。
exercises.upgrade: head out · 出門；外出

options.explanation: travelled = 可描述路程，但不如 head out 精確表達『出發』。
commuted = concert 不是通勤目的地。
visited = 不是拜訪。
walked = 可能不是步行去。
head out = early + concert 表示提早出發，headed out 最貼切。
stayed in = 和去演唱會相反。

words.note: 當 go out 的核心只是從家中出去時最直接；本身不一定表示娛樂，所以若是休閒語境，通常要靠上下文補足。
words.example: She rarely leaves the house on weekday evenings.

exercises.original: She hasn't gone out much since the weather turned cold.
exercises.zh: 天氣轉冷後，她很少離開家。
exercises.upgrade: leave the house · 離開家；出門

options.explanation: travelled = 可能完全沒有長途旅行，但仍可出門。
commuted = 句子不是工作通勤。
visited = 沒有具體拜訪對象。
leave the house = 這裡重點是她是否離開家本身，因此 leave the house 最直接。
walked = 即使不是走路，也可能外出。
gone outside = 只到門外也不等於真正離家活動。

exercises.original: He usually goes out at least once every weekend.
exercises.zh: 他通常每個週末至少會出門一次。
exercises.upgrade: leave the house · 離開家；出門

options.explanation: commutes = 週末未必上班，而且句子沒有工作線索。
travels = 外出不一定是旅行。
visits = 沒有固定拜訪對象。
walks = 可用其他交通方式。
leave the house = 若只強調週末是否有離家活動，leaves the house 很自然。
stays in = 意思相反。

exercises.original: After being ill for a week, she finally felt ready to go out.
exercises.zh: 病了一星期後，她終於覺得可以出門了。
exercises.upgrade: leave the house · 離開家；出門

options.explanation: commute = 康復後首次外出不一定是上班。
travel = 語氣過大。
visit = 未說拜訪任何人。
walk = 她可能乘車外出。
stay in = 和 finally ready 相反。
leave the house = 生病後第一次覺得能離開家，leave the house 比 general travel 更精確。

words.note: 當 go out 明確表示和朋友、同事或伴侶外出吃飯、喝東西或參加社交活動時很精確。
words.example: He goes out socially with colleagues about once a week.
words.exampleZh: 他大約每星期和同事外出社交一次。

exercises.original: She goes out with friends two or three times a month.
exercises.zh: 她每月和朋友外出社交兩三次。
exercises.upgrade: go out socially · 外出社交；出去聚會

options.explanation: commutes = 朋友聚會不是通勤。
travels = 每月社交未必涉及旅行。
visits = 有時可能拜訪，但原句是更廣泛的社交活動。
walks = 不等於社交聚會。
go out socially = with friends + regular leisure activity 明確表示社交外出。
goes outside = 只到戶外不足以表達 socializing。

exercises.original: He rarely goes out now that most of his friends have moved away.
exercises.zh: 大部分朋友搬走後，他現在很少外出社交。
exercises.upgrade: go out socially · 外出社交；出去聚會

options.explanation: travels = 朋友搬走和是否旅行沒有直接關係。
commutes = 不是工作路線。
visits = 原句不是特定拜訪。
walks = 不能解釋 friends moved away 對活動的影響。
leaves = 單純離開某處太廣。
go out socially = 朋友搬走導致外出變少，說明核心是 social activity。

exercises.original: We used to go out more often before we had children.
exercises.zh: 我們有孩子前以前更常外出社交。
exercises.upgrade: go out socially · 外出社交；出去聚會

options.explanation: go out socially = 家庭生活改變後社交娛樂次數下降，go out socially 最精確。
commute = 育兒前後並非通勤頻率對比。
travel = 可能旅行較少，但原句更一般指社交娛樂。
visit = 沒有特定拜訪對象。
walk = 不是運動頻率。
go outside = 有孩子後仍會到戶外，意思太字面。

words.note: 當 go out 指晚上離家吃飯、看表演、喝酒或參加其他休閒活動時很自然；比單純 head out 更強調晚間娛樂。
words.example: They went out for the evening after finishing work early.
words.exampleZh: 他們提早下班後，晚上外出消遣。

exercises.original: They decided to go out after work and have dinner together.
exercises.zh: 他們決定下班後晚上外出吃飯。
exercises.upgrade: go out for the evening · 晚上外出消遣

options.explanation: commute = 下班後活動不是通勤。
visit = 未說拜訪某人。
travel = 普通晚間活動不需用 travel。
walk = 吃飯不等於散步。
stay in = 意思相反。
go out for the evening = 下班後晚餐等娛樂活動最自然可說 go out for the evening。

exercises.original: We haven't gone out in ages, so let's book a restaurant and see a show.
exercises.zh: 我們很久沒有晚上外出了，所以訂間餐廳再看場表演吧。
exercises.upgrade: go out for the evening · 晚上外出消遣

options.explanation: go out for the evening = restaurant + show 是典型整晚休閒安排，最適合這個片語。
gone outside = 到戶外不能涵蓋 restaurant + show 的整晚活動。
travelled = 不是長途旅行。
commuted = 完全不合。
visited = 沒有拜訪目的。
walked = 不是單純步行。

exercises.original: They got a babysitter so they could go out together.
exercises.zh: 他們找了保母，好讓兩人晚上一起外出。
exercises.upgrade: go out for the evening · 晚上外出消遣

options.explanation: commute = 請 babysitter 不是為通勤。
go out for the evening = 安排 babysitter 通常是為較完整的晚間 leisure outing，因此 go out for the evening 很自然。
go outside = 只是出門口不需要特別找 babysitter。
travel = 未必離開本地。
visit = 未說去探訪。
walk = 未說散步。

words.note: 較口語，常表示短暫離開家、辦公室或其他地方；若要表達長時間娛樂活動，通常不如 go out / head out 自然。
words.example: I'm stepping out for coffee and will be back soon.
words.exampleZh: 我出去喝杯咖啡，很快回來。

exercises.original: I'm going out for ten minutes to get some coffee.
exercises.zh: 我出去十分鐘買杯咖啡。
exercises.upgrade: step out · 出去一下；短暫外出

options.explanation: step out = for ten minutes 表明只是短暫離開，step out 最自然。
travelling = 十分鐘買咖啡不是旅行。
commuting = 不是上下班。
staying in = 相反。
visiting = 不是拜訪。
going on an outing = 語氣過重，像完整休閒活動。

exercises.original: She went out briefly to make a phone call.
exercises.zh: 她短暫出去打電話。
exercises.upgrade: step out · 出去一下；短暫外出

options.explanation: travelled = 完全過度。
step out = briefly 是 step out 的直接線索。
commuted = 不合。
visited = 沒有拜訪對象。
walked away = 會增加離開位置／遠離的意味。
went on a trip = 明顯不合短暫外出。

exercises.original: He went out of the office to pick up lunch and came back twenty minutes later.
exercises.zh: 他離開辦公室去取午餐，二十分鐘後回來。
exercises.upgrade: step out · 出去一下；短暫外出

options.explanation: commuted = 不是下班回家。
travelled = 二十分鐘短程不需用 travel。
step out = 短時間離開 office 再回來，最自然是 step out。
visited = 不是探訪。
stayed in = 意思相反。
wandered = 沒有漫無目的地走動。

words.note: 表示離開家到外面活動、走動或做各種事情，常暗示一段時間內四處活動，而不是單一目的地。
words.example: She felt well enough to go out and about again.
words.exampleZh: 她覺得身體好轉，已可以再次外出活動。

exercises.original: After two weeks at home, she was happy to go out again and do normal activities.
exercises.zh: 在家兩星期後，她很高興再次外出活動，恢復日常生活。
exercises.upgrade: go out and about · 外出活動；到處走走

options.explanation: commute = 不只是恢復上班。
go out and about = 重新恢復在外面走動、辦事和活動，go out and about 最貼切。
travel = 不一定長途。
visit = 不是單一拜訪。
stay in = 相反。
go outside = 只到戶外不足以涵蓋 normal activities。

exercises.original: He is still recovering, but he can go out for short periods now.
exercises.zh: 他仍在康復，但現在已可以短時間外出活動。
exercises.upgrade: go out and about · 外出活動；到處走走

options.explanation: travel = 康復初期短時間活動不等於旅行。
commute = 未說恢復工作。
go out and about = 康復後逐漸能在外活動，go out and about 很自然。
visit = 可能包括拜訪，但意思太窄。
walk = 未必全部靠步行。
stay indoors = 相反。

exercises.original: Retirement gave them more time to go out, visit places, and enjoy the city.
exercises.zh: 退休讓他們有更多時間外出活動、到不同地方和享受城市生活。
exercises.upgrade: go out and about · 外出活動；到處走走

options.explanation: commute = 退休後反而不再規律通勤。
travel only = 可能只是本地活動，不必是旅行。
stay in = 和 enjoy the city 相反。
go out and about = 在城市中四處活動、享受生活的概念最適合 go out and about。
visit one person = 範圍太窄。
go outside briefly = 不能涵蓋城市中的多種活動。

words.note: 當 go out 帶有『原本不太想出去／有些困難或風險，但還是出門』的意味時很自然；常見於惡劣天氣、生病後或陌生地方。
words.example: We finally ventured out after the rain stopped.
words.exampleZh: 雨停後，我們終於走出門。

exercises.original: We didn't want to go out in the storm, but eventually we needed food.
exercises.zh: 我們不想在暴風雨中出門，但最後還是需要買食物。
exercises.upgrade: venture out · 鼓起勁外出；走出門

options.explanation: commute = 不是工作路線。
travel = 可能只是去附近商店。
venture out = 在惡劣天氣下勉強或鼓起勁外出，venture out 最精確。
visit = 沒有拜訪對象。
go outside casually = 忽略了 storm 帶來的困難／不情願。
stay in = 和 eventually needed food 的行動相反。

exercises.original: She finally went out alone after weeks of feeling nervous about the neighbourhood.
exercises.zh: 她因對附近環境感到緊張數星期後，終於獨自外出。
exercises.upgrade: venture out · 鼓起勁外出；走出門

options.explanation: commuted = 不是例行上班。
travelled = 未必離開附近區域。
visited = 不合。
venture out = finally + nervousness 顯示克服猶豫後出門，venture out 很自然。
walked = 可能不是單純散步。
went outside = 意思太中性，沒有 overcome hesitation 的意味。

exercises.original: The roads were icy, so few people went out that morning.
exercises.zh: 路面結冰，所以那天早上很少人冒險外出。
exercises.upgrade: venture out · 鼓起勁外出；走出門

options.explanation: commuted = 有人可能上班，但原句涵蓋所有外出。
travelled = 不一定有長途行程。
visited = 沒有拜訪線索。
walked = 冰路上可能駕車。
venture out = icy roads 帶來風險，因此 ventured out 比普通 went out 更精確。
went shopping = 過度限定目的。

words.note: 當 go out 的休閒活動明確是前往市中心、商業區或鎮中心時可用；這是目的地限定的情境化替換。
words.example: We went into town for dinner and a film.
words.exampleZh: 我們進城吃晚飯和看電影。

exercises.original: We went out for dinner and a movie in the city centre.
exercises.zh: 我們到市中心吃晚飯和看電影。
exercises.upgrade: go into town · 進城／到市中心外出

options.explanation: commuted = 晚餐電影不是通勤。
travelled = 語氣過廣，未必是旅行。
visited = 沒有拜訪某人。
go into town = 目的地明確是 city centre 的休閒活動，go into town 最自然。
stayed in = 相反。
went outside = 不能表達前往 town centre。

exercises.original: They often go out on Saturday afternoons to shop and have coffee downtown.
exercises.zh: 他們星期六下午常到市中心購物和喝咖啡。
exercises.upgrade: go into town · 進城／到市中心外出

options.explanation: commute = 週末 leisure activity 不是通勤。
visit = 並非去見特定對象。
travel = 普通本地 downtown 行程太大。
walk = 未必步行前往。
go into town = shopping + coffee + downtown 明確是到市中心活動。
stay home = 相反。

exercises.original: Let's go out tomorrow and have lunch somewhere in the centre.
exercises.zh: 我們明天到市中心找個地方吃午飯吧。
exercises.upgrade: go into town · 進城／到市中心外出

options.explanation: commute = 不是工作。
travel = 可能只是短程。
visit = 沒有固定拜訪地點。
go outside = 太字面，沒有 centre 目的地。
stay in = 意思相反。
go into town = somewhere in the centre 直接支持 go into town。

falseSynonyms.zh: 留在家中和 go out 相反 stay in 表示留在家或室內，不外出；和 leisure sense 的 go out 方向相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON To stay in is to remain at home; to go out is to leave home.

falseSynonyms.zh: 到戶外不一定等於外出消遣 go outside 只表示從室內到戶外，可能只是到花園或門口；go out 可表示整個外出活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Going outside may only mean stepping outdoors; going out often means leaving home for an activity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 離開範圍太廣 leave 可以離開任何地方、任何原因；go out 在這裡特指離家去休閒或社交。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Leave is general; go out can specifically mean leaving home for leisure.

falseSynonyms.zh: 旅行不等於一般外出 travel 通常涉及較長距離或從一地到另一地；一般晚上出去吃飯不會稱 travel。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Travel usually involves a journey; going out may only involve a local social activity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 通勤不等於休閒外出 commute 是規律往返住所和工作／學校；和為娛樂而 go out 不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Commuting is routine travel to work or study; going out is often for leisure.

falseSynonyms.zh: 散步不等於所有 go out walk 描述移動方式；go out 可以搭車、坐巴士或只是到餐廳，不一定步行。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Walking is a mode of movement; going out describes leaving home for an activity.

falseSynonyms.zh: 拜訪不等於一般外出 visit 需要有具體人或地方作目的地；go out 可以沒有拜訪對象。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A visit has a specific person or place as its destination; going out is broader.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動詞片語與名詞不同 go out 是動詞片語；outing 是名詞，表示一次外出活動或短途活動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We went out after lunch. The school organized an outing.
